integrity: The edge list, enumeration, trace census, symmetry-orbit table, exact rational boundary rank, unimodular 25x25 minor, and two independent finite verification programs are included as standalone reproducible files.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification only for the three-dimensional binary cube. No formula for higher-dimensional cubes and no sphere-wedge homotopy type are claimed. Historical priority beyond the inspected literature is not guaranteed; relevant third-party repository full texts were not uniformly accessible. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Maximal-matchings of the three-cube: a forbidden-parallel-triple shattering law and two-degree integral homology
